description: GET /{WABA-ID}/message_templates is a paged Graph API list, but the spec declares only the `name` query parameter and `paging.cursors` in the response. Live on 2026-11-18 (v23.0): `?limit=2&fields=name` returned two templates (only `name` and `id`) with `paging: { cursors: { before, after }, next }`; passing `after=<paging.cursors.after>` returned the next page with `cursors`, `next` and `previous`, and the final page `cursors` and `previous` with no `next`. The request gains `limit`, `after` and `fields`; the response paging gains `next` and `previous`.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Maximum number of templates to return per page.
Cursor for pagination: `paging.cursors.after` of the previous page.
URL of the next page; absent on the last page.
URL of the previous page; absent on the first page.
